notes.title: Downward Spiral: Horus Station out now!
notes.notes:
Downward Spiral: Prologue was just the beginning! 

The sequel, Downward Spiral: Horus Station, is now available on Steam for super low price of $19.99 / €14.99 / £14.99. The game features full fledged single player campaign with co-op as well as extra multiplayer game modes to keep the zero g experience going for hours. You can find it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/690620/Downward_Spiral_Horus_Station/

Welcome on board the station!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28151092/f3f33a6317edf55a202dde1c65403c7954457cef.png[/img]

notes.title: Downward Spiral: Horus Station continues the space adventure May 31st!
notes.notes:
If you liked Prologue, you are going to love Horus Station! The sequel is coming to Steam on May 31st this time with optional VR support. 

The price is $19,99 or 14,99€, and it includes 4-6 hours story campaign, co-op, Deathmatch and Horde modes. 

Check out the Downward Spiral: Horus Station game page here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/690620/Downward_Spiral_Horus_Station/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28151092/968e74663d6a7507aedaa4136895e7854f28d573.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Downward Spiral: Horus Station - Coming Soon
Downward Spiral: Horus Station - Coming Soon
We have update for the game!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28151092/b13ac1cc2875e36db8a8210d45a1c892074d0e56.png[/img]

Hi guys!

We did some updates to Deathmatch, like adding shields. Now we have new update which includes following things:

-Player is taken now directly to the Deathmatch scene to wait for other players
-When waiting for other deathmatch players, orbs are spawned to keep you busy
-Added 3 new achievements
-Tweaked enemy behaviour

Have fun!
